lines.zh: 这条通道只够我一只过。
lines.en: This tunnel is barely wide enough for me.
The old nest's sand is still loose.
The ceiling shakes. Someone is digging.
The wind blows sand into my shell seams.
Who dragged dead leaves into my path?

lines.zh: 这条隧道我挖了上千回。
lines.en: I've dug this tunnel a thousand times.

lines.zh: 后面只有我自己的脚印。
lines.en: Only my own prints lie behind me.

lines.zh: 左边第三条腿磨得发亮。
lines.en: My third left leg is worn shiny.

lines.zh: 沙粒从我的甲缝里漏下去。
lines.en: Sand leaks through the seams of my armor.
Two more tunnel stretches and I rest.
After a molt I lie still a whole day.
I walk these sand tunnels daily.
Follow the scent trail and you can't go wrong.
Softly. Someone is walking overhead.

lines.zh: 我扛着一粒沙，往巢里走。
lines.en: Carrying a grain of sand, I head for the nest.
The nest smell is just ahead.
I dig these sand tunnels every day.
I crouch at the nest mouth, listening to the sand.
The sand shifts, not me.
Under the sand are all the roads I dug.
My antennae droop into a doze.

lines.zh: 我扛着一粒沙，比我头还大。
lines.en: I carry a grain of sand bigger than my head.

lines.zh: 沙漠地下这么干，我的颚都磨钝了。
lines.en: The desert underground is so dry my jaws dull.
So many eyes, so much drowsiness.

lines.zh: 沙底下钻出来，今天该换壳。
lines.en: Out from under the sand, time to shed again.
Carrying honeydew back to the nest.

lines.zh: 沙下的工蚁，举着火把走。
lines.en: Down in the sand, I carry a torch.

lines.zh: 数一数沙里有多少粒给我搬。
lines.en: Let me count the grains left to carry.

lines.zh: 你的味道，我记进巢里了。
lines.en: I file your scent away in the nest.

lines.zh: 沙漠地下的路，我们挖了两百条。
lines.en: We dug two hundred tunnels under the sand.
I think I've seen your footprints before.

lines.zh: 沙漠底下，我挖了一整片。
lines.en: Under the desert, I dug a whole field.

lines.zh: 你比一只沙虫大太多了。
lines.en: You're far bigger than a sand worm.
Stand still. Let me sniff your boot.
Footsteps under the sand are too loud.

lines.zh: 别弯腰，你的影子压下来。
lines.en: Don't bend over. Your shadow presses down.
Your fingers look soft enough.
Not Ant Worker? Then who?
My mandibles can still bite.
Hit me again and I'll call the whole nest.
The plate on my back split in two.
Pain like this happens in the nest daily.
This isn't over. My nest is still there.

lines.zh: 我的护甲上多了个白印。
lines.en: A pale nick shows on my armor.

lines.zh: 甲壳凹了一块，还撑得住。
lines.en: My shell is dented, but it holds.
Who struck me from behind?
Half an antenna lies in the sand.
My mandibles can't bite this plate.

lines.zh: 工蚁的颚夹着蜜汁不放。
lines.en: The worker ant's mandibles will not release the honey.
Give me half. I can carry it.
That sweetness goes back to the nest.

lines.zh: 你晃得我触角都跟着转。
lines.en: Your waving pulls my antennae along.
Just one lick. I won't bite your hand.
Sweet, or iron?

lines.zh: 我扛着木棍，从沙下上来。
lines.en: I come up from the sand with a wooden club.

lines.zh: 这东西能搬回沙漠地下的巢吗？
lines.en: Can this go back to the burrow under the desert?
A sweet leaf. I'll drag it home.
This smells of honey, not insect.
One bite and your hands slow.
One swing and sand flies.
You moved first. I didn't give way.
Slow down. My legs are only this long.
Go around, or we bump again.

lines.zh: 沙漠地下的工蚁，扛着沙走。
lines.en: A worker under the desert carries its sand.

lines.zh: 我扛着木棍，从洞里爬出。
lines.en: Wooden club on my shoulder, I climb out.

lines.zh: 沙漠地底的隧道是我的。
lines.en: The tunnels under this desert are mine.
You stepped on me, and I bumped you back.
My antennae tangle from the bump.
Don't go. It's warm beneath the sand.
The nest floor is lined with warm dry grass.
Come with me. The nest is under the sand.

lines.zh: 你和其他蚂蚁都不太一样。
lines.en: You're not quite like the other ants.
Come back to the nest, I know the way.
Don't fear; worker ant fangs are shallow.

lines.zh: 你比我爬得快，这不合适。
lines.en: You crawl faster than me. That won't do.
You carry the smell of pollen.

lines.zh: 搬家时你扛大的，我扛小的。
lines.en: When we move, you take the big loads.
My mandibles bite through leather.

lines.zh: 我捡的绿染料，是磨出来的。
lines.en: The green dye I carry is ground from moss.

lines.zh: 沙漠地下的蜜，味道不错。
lines.en: Desert honey tastes good down here.
One more piece for the nest.
This iron nugget is worth half a nest of honey.
My mandibles can carry this piece.
This is bigger than my head.

lines.zh: 我扛着一粒比头大的沙。
lines.en: I haul a grain of sand bigger than my head.
Which storehouse does this grain go in?

lines.zh: 我把它塞进颚后面藏好。
lines.en: I tuck it behind my mandibles.
I can carry this grain.
Under the sand you can't run fast.
Good. This prey belongs to the nest now.
Your size will fit through the nest mouth.
It moved, and my mandibles moved too.
Beneath the sand, I count to three.

lines.zh: 你踩进巢口了，退不出去。
lines.en: You've stepped into the nest mouth. No way out.
Do you hear that sound under the sand?

lines.zh: 你正好挡在回巢的路上。
lines.en: You're right on my way home.
Something living moves on the sand.
All six legs turn toward you at once.

lines.zh: 沙底下，你的脚步我数得清。
lines.en: I can count your steps under the sand.

lines.zh: 我的巢里没剩几颗蜜了。
lines.en: Not many honey drops are left in my nest.
Run, and I'll follow the tremors.
There's only one path around here.
Don't step on my tunnel mouth.

lines.zh: 沙漠地下的工蚁，扛着木棍。
lines.en: A desert worker ant, hauling a club.
Wooden club in hand, and it lifts fine.

lines.zh: 沙上那串印子，是你留的。
lines.en: Those prints in the sand are yours.

lines.zh: 我从侧面的沙堆绕过去。
lines.en: I circle around by the sand pile.
Six legs take turns. I don't tire.

lines.zh: 我举着木棍，从沙底爬上来。
lines.en: I climb from under the sand with a wooden club.
Turning won't help. I have six legs.

lines.zh: 沙面上我的六只脚在追。
lines.en: Six feet of mine are racing across the sand.

lines.zh: 你踩沙的声音太清楚了。
lines.en: Your steps on the sand are too clear.
That was only the first bite.
My venom-coated jaws landed.
My mandibles have closed. Don't blame me for not letting go.
Good dodge. I saw it all.
An ant under sand digs, not fights.

lines.zh: 我的木剑也会让你变慢。
lines.en: Even my wooden sword slows you.
Back off. My mandibles are still open.

lines.zh: 这一下对准了你的脚踝。
lines.en: This strike aims at your ankle.
My wooden club cracks against your knee.

lines.zh: 小个子也能拖倒大东西。
lines.en: A small one can still pull down something big.

lines.zh: 我从沙下的巢口钻出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of the nest mouth beneath the sand.

lines.zh: 我的复眼把沙粒放得很大。
lines.en: My compound eyes magnify every grain.

lines.zh: 正午的沙面烫着我的甲。
lines.en: The noon sand burns my armor.
I remember the smell of my nest.
Desert moonlight reaches the burrow mouth.

lines.zh: 我刚顶开沙盖，就看见你。
lines.en: I push off the sand lid and there you are.

lines.zh: 沙漠地下，全是我们的路。
lines.en: The whole underdesert is our road.
I didn't dig this layer of soil.
The nest caved in. I must dig another way.
Sand slides off my back.
I resist fire, but my shell is popping.
I fell from the burrow roof. My legs still tingle.
Water floods my spiracles. I can't breathe.
The blast buried my nest mouth.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的腹节，留下沙。
lines.en: The arrow grazes my abdomen, leaving sand.

lines.zh: 魔法让我的触角失了方向。
lines.en: The magic leaves my antennae without direction.

lines.zh: 沙漠地下，我的六条腿都在抖。
lines.en: Underground, all six of my legs are trembling.
Lightning runs through the sand into my shell.

lines.zh: 连一粒沙都抓不住，往下掉。
lines.en: Not one grain to grip; I keep falling.
